tool_input.command: git stash push app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts -q && bun test tests/PostSearch.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -8; git stash pop -q && git diff --stat

result: The bug was in `PostController.search` (`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts:33`): the `published` check was written as `q.orWhere('published', true)` *inside* the same grouping callback as the keyword `LIKE` clauses, so the generated SQL was `title LIKE … OR excerpt LIKE … OR published = 1` — an unpublished post matched on a keyword alone, and every published post matched on the trailing `published` term alone (which is where the "results padded with posts that don't contain the search word" came from). I moved the published filter out to the top level as `.where('published', true)` and left only the keyword `orWhere` pair inside the callback, so the ORM emits `published = 1 AND (title LIKE … OR excerpt LIKE … OR …)`; I verified this against the real SQLite query builder (the old form returned the draft plus padding, the new one returns exactly the published match, for one and for two keywords). I also added `tests/PostSearch.test.ts`, which boots the real app, force-creates published and unpublished fixture posts under a dedicated author (cleaned up in `afterAll`), and asserts that a single keyword, two keywords, an unpublished-only keyword, and an excerpt-only match all return exactly the published matches and nothing else. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (7 tests, 0 failures).
